policies.review: Reviewed exact retained exclusions and current official page. The two /chips/ index roots and their single page=N query are not excluded. Search, facet and archive routes are not approved; this is not permission for unrestricted crawling.

Reviewed current NIST public-information notice and exact retained policy. Marked copyrighted material and product-specific exceptions remain excluded. Retain HTML locally; public outputs for this pilot are original operational analysis and source locators. No image, logo, linked attachment, third-party republication or blanket document rights are granted.

indexes.scope: Visible nist-teaser article records and their explicit sequential pager. Publisher teaser date is preserved verbatim; footer Updated is not a news date. The separately linked archive is excluded; this current page chain is not complete historical coverage.

Visible award cards and explicit sequential pager; retain CHIPS Program Office entries, count excluded offices. Mutable project directory, not a chronological news feed. Locality and region are source-native routing context, not verified facility identity.

routing_note: Retain all eligible entries. Case-insensitive bounded aliases for all seven baseline companies only prioritize review, never establish a facility match. U.S. Micron and SK hynix entries do not refresh Singapore or M15X. A Samsung Taylor directory link does not authorize Samsung-controlled newsroom collection. Existing curated document plans and queues are unchanged.
validity_note: Thirty-day internal review deadline. Every run first checks both current normalized policy hashes. Only the exact roots and same-root single page=N links with N incrementing by one are approved. Failed, incomplete, empty or rolling-window results are never negative facility evidence.
